# GateVerse

> GateVerse (جيت فيرس) is a 3D virtual tour studio in Alexandria, Egypt. It scans real places with professional 3D cameras and delivers an interactive tour (a "digital twin") with in-tour measurements on a shareable link plus an embed code, within 48 hours of the shoot. Tours open in any browser on phone, tablet or computer, with no app. Prices are fixed packages by area, starting at 950 EGP.

GateVerse is not only for real estate. It shoots any place a customer needs to see before they come: apartments, villas and duplexes; event and wedding venues; cafés and restaurants; gyms; hotels; spas; kids areas; and coworking / work spaces. Visitors walk through every room from their phone before they book, buy, rent or visit, so the people who call or come are ready to decide. The website is in Arabic (Egyptian); service is available in Arabic and English.

## Packages and prices (Egyptian pounds, EGP)

Every package includes a full 360° 3D tour of the place, a direct share link and an embed code for any website. The price depends on the area of the place:

| Package | Area up to | Price | Typical places | Free hosting | Info points inside the tour | Priority delivery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter (باقة البداية) | 100 m² | 950 EGP | studio, small apartment, café or shop | 1 month | no | no |
| Bronze (الباقة البرونزية) | 150 m² | 1,950 EGP | apartment, clinic, spa or kids area | 2 months | no | no |
| Silver (الباقة الفضية) — most requested | 250 m² | 2,950 EGP | duplex, restaurant, gym or work space | 3 months | yes | yes |
| Gold (الباقة الذهبية) | 450 m² | 4,950 EGP | villa, event venue or large place | 4 months | yes | yes |

- After the free hosting period the tour stays online for 100 EGP per month or 1,000 EGP per year.
- Places larger than 450 m²: custom quote on WhatsApp.
- Add-ons: interactive point / pop-up (an image, video or product details inside the tour) 100 EGP per point; still photo 100 EGP; short promo video (ready-made social media reel) 400 EGP; extra floor 400 EGP; tour update if the place changes: 50% of the package price.
- Payment: cash, bank transfer or InstaPay.

## What a tour includes

- Immersive 360° 3D scan of the whole place (a digital twin), with a dollhouse view
- Interactive measurements inside the tour
- Optional clickable points of interest: menu, membership prices, marble type, appliance brands, an intro video
- A permanent link to share on WhatsApp, social media and Google Maps, plus an embed code (iframe) for any website or property portal

## How it works

1. Booking: send the type of place, its location and approximate area on WhatsApp to confirm the package and the appointment
2. On-site scan: a GateVerse engineer scans the whole place (1–2 hours)
3. Processing: lighting, dimensions and the 3D model are prepared
4. Delivery: the tour link and embed code are delivered within 48 hours of the shoot

## Work (live tours you can open)

- [The Circle](https://www.gateverse.net/tour/the-circle): a coworking / work space in Alexandria
- [King Gym](https://www.gateverse.net/tour/king-gym): a gym in Alexandria
- [Shaghof](https://www.gateverse.net/tour/shaghof): a cultural and art space in Alexandria

## Who it is for

- Real estate agents, brokers, owners and developers listing apartments, villas and duplexes
- Event and wedding venues, cafés, restaurants, gyms, hotels, spas and kids areas that want customers to see the place before booking
- Coworking spaces, work spaces and cultural spaces whose members choose their spot from their phone

## FAQ

Q: How much does a 3D virtual tour cost with GateVerse?
A: It is a fixed package by area: up to 100 m² 950 EGP, up to 150 m² 1,950 EGP, up to 250 m² 2,950 EGP, up to 450 m² 4,950 EGP. Each includes 1 to 4 months of free hosting, then 100 EGP per month (or 1,000 EGP per year). Larger places get a custom quote.

Q: Is it only for real estate?
A: No. GateVerse shoots apartments and villas, event venues, cafés and restaurants, gyms, hotels, spas, kids areas and work spaces.

Q: How long does production take?
A: The finished tour link is delivered within 48 hours of the shoot. The on-site scan takes 1–2 hours.

Q: Does it work on mobile and on websites?
A: Yes. It runs in the browser on all devices without an app, can be sent on WhatsApp, and can be embedded on any website or property portal.

Q: Where does GateVerse work?
A: In Alexandria, Egypt.
